description: Fauji Cement Company Limited (FCCL) is a Fauji Foundation company that manufactures and sells cement and tile bond. It describes itself as Pakistan's third largest cement producer, with an annual production capacity of 10.6 million tons across four cement plants - at Jhang Bahtar, Nizampur, Wah and Dera Ghazi Khan - and a polypropylene cement bag plant at Hattar. The company also states that it is the largest cement supplier to all major hydro power projects in Pakistan.
